D/ CONSTANTI NVS MAX AVG ; R/ GLOR IA EXER CITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (396-337), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Lyons mint, Reece period 17. RIC volume 7 no. 243. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTI NVS MAX AVG. Reverse description: two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IA EXER CITVS. In exergue: . PLG. Diameter: 15.4mm, Weight:…
